definition: make sure or demonstrate that something is true, accurate, or justified
example_sentence: Independent researchers attempted to verify the original experimental findings.
turkish_translation: Bağımsız araştırmacılar orijinal deneysel bulguları doğrulamaya çalıştılar.
collocations: verify results; verify identity; independently verify; verify hypothesis

definition: rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
example_sentence: Exchange rates fluctuate daily depending on global market conditions.
turkish_translation: Döviz kurları küresel piyasa koşullarına bağlı olarak günlük olarak dalgalanır.
collocations: fluctuate wildly; wildly fluctuating; prices fluctuate; temperature fluctuates

definition: combine one thing with another so that they become a whole
example_sentence: The university aims to integrate technology seamlessly into traditional teaching methods.
turkish_translation: Üniversite, teknolojiyi geleneksel öğretim yöntemlerine sorunsuz bir şekilde entegre etmeyi amaçlamaktadır.
collocations: integrate into; fully integrate; integrate technology; integrate systems

definition: a part or element of a larger whole, especially a part of a machine or vehicle
example_sentence: Critical thinking is an essential component of higher education curricula.
turkish_translation: Eleştirel düşünme, yükseköğretim müfredatının temel bir bileşenidir.
collocations: key component; essential component; system component; structural component

definition: regard something as being caused by someone or something
example_sentence: Economists attribute the rise in inflation to supply chain disruptions.
turkish_translation: Ekonomistler enflasyondaki artışı tedarik zinciri aksamalarına bağlıyor.
collocations: attribute to; directly attribute; main attribute; essential attribute

definition: continuing firmly or obstinately in an opinion or course of action in spite of difficulty
example_sentence: Persistent drought conditions have led to severe water shortages across the region.
turkish_translation: Kalıcı/süregelen kuraklık koşulları, bölge genelinde ciddi su sıkıntısına yol açtı.
collocations: persistent problem; persistent effort; persistent symptoms; persistent belief

definition: make something suitable for a new use or purpose; modify
example_sentence: Species must adapt to changing environmental conditions to avoid extinction.
turkish_translation: Türlerin yok olmaktan kaçınmak için değişen çevre koşullarına uyum sağlaması gerekir.
collocations: adapt to; adapt quickly; adapt strategy; successfully adapt

definition: cause an event or situation to happen or exist
example_sentence: Environmental stress can trigger genetic mutations in susceptible organisms.
turkish_translation: Çevresel stres, duyarlı organizmalarda genetik mutasyonları tetikleyebilir.
collocations: trigger response; trigger reaction; main trigger; trigger event

definition: imitate the appearance or character of something
example_sentence: Computer models can simulate complex climate scenarios over centuries.
turkish_translation: Bilgisayar modelleri, yüzyıllar boyunca karmaşık iklim senaryolarını simüle edebilir.
collocations: simulate conditions; simulate environment; computer simulate; accurately simulate

definition: the extent of the area or subject matter that something deals with or to which it is relevant
example_sentence: The study's scope was limited to urban secondary schools in the region.
turkish_translation: Çalışmanın kapsamı bölgedeki kentsel ortaöğretim okulları ile sınırlandırılmıştır.
collocations: broad scope; limited scope; scope of study; beyond the scope

definition: strengthen or support physically or mentally; maintain over a period of time
example_sentence: High levels of investment are required to sustain economic growth.
turkish_translation: Ekonomik büyümeyi sürdürmek için yüksek düzeyde yatırım gereklidir.
collocations: sustain growth; sustain life; sustain damage; sustain effort

definition: showing a great deal of variety; very different
example_sentence: The university boasts a culturally diverse student body from over 100 countries.
turkish_translation: Üniversite, 100'den fazla ülkeden gelen kültürel açıdan çeşitli bir öğrenci kitlesine sahiptir.
collocations: diverse background; diverse views; culturally diverse; diverse range

definition: best or most favorable; achieving the best possible outcome
example_sentence: The algorithm seeks to find the optimal solution while minimizing computing power.
turkish_translation: Algoritma, işlem gücünü en aza indirirken optimal çözümü bulmaya çalışır.
collocations: optimal conditions; optimal performance; optimal result; optimal level

definition: strengthen or support an object, substance, or opinion
example_sentence: Recent experimental data reinforce the validity of the proposed theory.
turkish_translation: Son deneysel veriler önerilen teorinin geçerliliğini pekiştirmektedir.
collocations: reinforce learning; reinforce belief; reinforce structure; strongly reinforce

definition: recognize or point out a difference between people or things
example_sentence: It is essential to distinguish between correlation and causation in scientific analysis.
turkish_translation: Bilimsel analizde korelasyon ile nedensellik arasında ayrım yapmak şarttır.
collocations: distinguish between; clearly distinguish; distinguish feature; ability to distinguish

definition: place or arrange things in a straight line or in correct relative positions; bring into agreement
example_sentence: Educational goals must align with career market requirements.
turkish_translation: Eğitim hedefleri kariyer piyasasının gereksinimleriyle hizalanmalıdır/uyumlu olmalıdır.
collocations: align with; closely align; align goals; strategic alignment

definition: identify clearly and definitely; state a requirement explicitly
example_sentence: The contract must specify the exact delivery dates and payment terms.
turkish_translation: Sözleşme kesin teslimat tarihlerini ve ödeme koşullarını açıkça belirtmelidir.
collocations: clearly specify; specify details; explicitly specify; specify conditions

definition: make an action or process easy or easier
example_sentence: Modern software tools facilitate collaboration among international research teams.
turkish_translation: Modern yazılım araçları uluslararası araştırma ekipleri arasında işbirliğini kolaylaştırır.
collocations: facilitate learning; facilitate communication; facilitate process; greatly facilitate

definition: manifest or display a quality, feeling, or type of behavior
example_sentence: Patients with this genetic condition exhibit increased sensitivity to sunlight.
turkish_translation: Bu genetik duruma sahip hastalar güneş ışığına karşı artan bir hassasiyet sergilerler.
collocations: exhibit symptoms; exhibit behavior; exhibit properties; clearly exhibit

definition: change the form, character, or function of something
example_sentence: Solar panels convert sunlight into electrical energy efficiently.
turkish_translation: Güneş panelleri güneş ışığını verimli bir şekilde elektrik enerjisine dönüştürür.
collocations: convert into; convert energy; convert data; easily convert

definition: remove or take out, especially by effort or force
example_sentence: Researchers use specialized techniques to extract DNA from ancient bone samples.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar antik kemik örneklerinden DNA çıkarmak için özel teknikler kullanırlar.
collocations: extract data; extract DNA; extract information; extract value

definition: remove impurities or unwanted elements from; improve something by making small changes
example_sentence: Scientists continue to refine the model to improve prediction accuracy.
turkish_translation: Bilim insanları tahmin doğruluğunu artırmak için modeli iyileştirmeye/geliştirmeye devam ediyor.
collocations: refine method; refine technique; refine model; further refine

definition: handle or control a tool, mechanism, or data in a skillful manner
example_sentence: Statisticians can manipulate large datasets to reveal underlying trends.
turkish_translation: İstatistikçiler temel eğilimleri ortaya çıkarmak için büyük veri kümelerini yönlendirebilir/işleyebilirler.
collocations: manipulate data; manipulate variables; skillfully manipulate; genetic manipulation

definition: roughly calculate or judge the value, number, quantity, or extent of
example_sentence: Demographers estimate that the global population will peak by mid-century.
turkish_translation: Demograflar küresel nüfusun yüzyılın ortalarında zirveye ulaşacağını tahmin ediyor.
collocations: estimate cost; estimate size; roughly estimate; accurately estimate

definition: give someone something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury; counterbalance
example_sentence: The body attempts to compensate for oxygen loss by increasing heart rate.
turkish_translation: Vücut kalp atış hızını artırarak oksijen kaybını telafi etmeye çalışır.
collocations: compensate for; fully compensate; compensate loss; financially compensate

definition: cause something to pass on from one place or person to another
example_sentence: Nerve fibers transmit electrical signals rapidly to the central nervous system.
turkish_translation: Sinir lifleri elektrik sinyallerini merkezi sinir sistemine hızla iletir.
collocations: transmit signals; transmit data; transmit disease; wirelessly transmit

definition: make a statement or situation less confused and more comprehensible
example_sentence: The professor added an appendix to clarify complex mathematical proofs.
turkish_translation: Profesör karmaşık matematiksel ispatları açıklığa kavuşturmak için bir ek ekledi.
collocations: clarify meaning; clarify position; help clarify; further clarify

definition: gather together or acquire an increasing number or quantity of
example_sentence: Toxins can accumulate in animal tissues over prolonged exposure periods.
turkish_translation: Toksinler uzun süreli maruz kalma dönemlerinde hayvan dokularında birikebilir.
collocations: accumulate data; accumulate wealth; gradually accumulate; accumulate evidence

definition: become aware or conscious of something; come to realize or understand
example_sentence: Individuals perceive risk differently depending on personal experience and knowledge.
turkish_translation: Bireyler kişisel deneyim ve bilgi birikimlerine bağlı olarak riski farklı şekilde algılarlar.
collocations: perceive threat; perceive risk; clearly perceive; perceive as

definition: form an idea of the amount, number, or value of; assess
example_sentence: Researchers must evaluate the effectiveness of interventions using objective measures.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar müdahalelerin etkinliğini objektif ölçütler kullanarak değerlendirmelidir.
collocations: evaluate performance; evaluate impact; critically evaluate; evaluate effectiveness

definition: cause something, especially emotion or action, to arise or come about
example_sentence: Renewable energy technologies generate electricity without direct carbon emissions.
turkish_translation: Yenilenebilir enerji teknolojileri, doğrudan karbon emisyonu olmadan elektrik üretir.
collocations: generate power; generate income; generate interest; generate revenue

definition: put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect
example_sentence: Hospitals implemented new infection control measures during the outbreak.
turkish_translation: Hastaneler salgın sırasında yeni enfeksiyon kontrol önlemlerini uygulamaya koydu.
collocations: implement policy; implement strategy; successfully implement; implement changes

definition: intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of
example_sentence: Regular physical exercise can significantly enhance cognitive performance.
turkish_translation: Düzenli fiziksel egzersiz bilişsel performansı önemli ölçüde artırabilir/geliştirebilir.
collocations: enhance quality; enhance performance; greatly enhance; enhance efficiency

definition: cause or enable a condition or state of affairs to continue; assert
example_sentence: The body works constantly to maintain homeostatic equilibrium.
turkish_translation: Vücut homeostatik dengeyi korumak için sürekli çalışır.
collocations: maintain balance; maintain standards; maintain contact; maintain control

definition: bring back a previous normal condition, situation, or feeling
example_sentence: Conservation programs aim to restore degraded coastal ecosystems.
turkish_translation: Koruma programları bozulmuş kıyı ekosistemlerini eski haline getirmeyi/restore etmeyi amaçlamaktadır.
collocations: restore balance; restore confidence; restore order; fully restore

definition: give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing
example_sentence: The curriculum emphasizes critical thinking and practical problem-solving skills.
turkish_translation: Müfredat eleştirel düşünme ve pratik problem çözme becerilerini vurgulamaktadır.
collocations: emphasize importance; strongly emphasize; emphasize need; emphasize role

definition: cause a process or action to begin
example_sentence: The institution plans to initiate a longitudinal study on youth development.
turkish_translation: Kurum, gençlik gelişimi üzerine uzunlamasına bir çalışma başlatmayı planlıyor.
collocations: initiate process; initiate contact; initiate discussion; initiate project

definition: put a limit on; keep under control
example_sentence: Ethical guidelines restrict the use of animal testing in cosmetic research.
turkish_translation: Etik kurallar kozmetik araştırmalarında hayvan deneylerinin kullanımını kısıtlamaktadır.
collocations: restrict access; severely restrict; restrict movement; restrict use

definition: provide sufficient space for; fit in with the wishes or needs of
example_sentence: The new facility was designed to accommodate up to 500 research scholars.
turkish_translation: Yeni tesis, 500 kadar araştırmacıyı barındıracak/ağırlayacak şekilde tasarlandı.
collocations: accommodate needs; accommodate growth; accommodate changes; easily accommodate

definition: make partial or minor changes to something, typically so as to improve it
example_sentence: Engineers modified the original design to improve aerodynamic efficiency.
turkish_translation: Mühendisler, aerodinamik verimliliği artırmak için orijinal tasarımı değiştirdi/değişikliğe uğrattı.
collocations: modify behavior; modify structure; slightly modify; genetically modify

definition: control or maintain the rate or speed of a process so that it operates properly
example_sentence: Hormones regulate various metabolic processes within the human body.
turkish_translation: Hormonlar insan vücudundaki çeşitli metabolik süreçleri düzenler.
collocations: regulate temperature; strictly regulate; regulate market; regulate body

definition: make a thorough or dramatic change in the form, appearance, or character of
example_sentence: Digital technology has transformed how academic research is conducted and shared.
turkish_translation: Dijital teknoloji, akademik araştırmaların yürütülme ve paylaşılma şeklini dönüştürdü.
collocations: completely transform; transform lives; transform industry; transform society

definition: completely remove or get rid of something
example_sentence: The new manufacturing technique helps eliminate material waste during production.
turkish_translation: Yeni üretim tekniği, üretim sırasında malzeme israfını ortadan kaldırmaya yardımcı oluyor.
collocations: eliminate risk; completely eliminate; eliminate waste; eliminate errors

definition: take in or contain something as part of a whole; include
example_sentence: The revised framework incorporates feedback from international peer reviewers.
turkish_translation: Gözden geçirilmiş çerçeve, uluslararası hakemlerin geri bildirimlerini bünyesine katmaktadır/içermektedir.
collocations: incorporate into; fully incorporate; incorporate feedback; incorporate features

definition: distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose
example_sentence: The committee decided to allocate additional funding to medical research projects.
turkish_translation: Komite, tıp araştırmaları projelerine ek fon tahsis etmeye karar verdi.
collocations: allocate resources; allocate budget; allocate funds; allocate time

definition: set up an organization, system, or set of rules on a firm or permanent basis
example_sentence: The researchers aimed to establish a causal relationship between the two variables.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar iki değişken arasında nedensel bir ilişki kurmayı/tespit etmeyi amaçladılar.
collocations: establish contact; establish relationship; establish framework; firmly establish

definition: clearly show the existence or truth of something by giving proof or evidence
example_sentence: Clinical trials demonstrate the safety and efficacy of the new vaccine candidate.
turkish_translation: Klinik deneyler, yeni aşı adayının güvenliğini ve etkinliğini kanıtlamaktadır/göstermektedir.
collocations: demonstrate competence; clearly demonstrate; demonstrate capability; demonstrate effectiveness

definition: be a part of a whole; combine to form something
example_sentence: Small and medium-sized enterprises constitute the vast majority of local businesses.
turkish_translation: Küçük ve orta ölçekli işletmeler, yerel işletmelerin ezici çoğunluğunu oluşturmaktadır.
collocations: constitute majority; constitute threat; constitute basis; legally constitute

definition: settle or find a solution to a problem or dispute
example_sentence: Diplomatic negotiations helped resolve the border dispute peacefully.
turkish_translation: Diplomatik müzakereler sınır anlaşmazlığının barışçıl bir şekilde çözülmesine yardımcı oldu.
collocations: resolve conflict; resolve issue; successfully resolve; resolve crisis

definition: cause a person or place to be or remain alone or apart from others
example_sentence: Laboratory technicians were able to isolate the compound responsible for the reaction.
turkish_translation: Laboratuvar teknisyenleri reaksiyondan sorumlu bileşiği izole etmeyi/ayıştırmayı başardılar.
collocations: isolate gene; isolate virus; completely isolate; isolate variable

definition: carry out a formal inquiry or systematic study to discover facts
example_sentence: The study was conducted to investigate the impact of sleep deprivation on memory.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, uyku yoksunluğunun hafıza üzerindeki etkisini araştırmak amacıyla yürütülmüştür.
collocations: thoroughly investigate; investigate cause; investigate effect; investigate incident

definition: check or prove the validity or accuracy of something
example_sentence: Further empirical studies are required to validate the theoretical findings.
turkish_translation: Teorik bulguları doğrulamak/geçerli kılmak için ek ampirik çalışmalara ihtiyaç vardır.
collocations: validate model; validate findings; empirically validate; validate claim

definition: plan and direct the course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport; manage a complex situation
example_sentence: Organizations must learn to navigate complex regulatory environments successfully.
turkish_translation: Kuruluşlar karmaşık düzenleyici ortamlarda başarıyla yol almayı/yön bulmayı öğrenmelidir.
collocations: navigate system; navigate terrain; successfully navigate; navigate challenge

definition: evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of
example_sentence: Standardized tests are used to assess student learning outcomes at the end of the year.
turkish_translation: Yıl sonunda öğrenci öğrenme çıktılarını değerlendirmek için standartlaştırılmış testler kullanılır.
collocations: assess risk; assess impact; assess quality; accurately assess

definition: produce a list or report by assembling information collected from other sources
example_sentence: The research team spent months compiling data from national census records.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi ulusal nüfus sayımı kayıtlarından veri derlemek için aylar harcadı.
collocations: compile data; compile report; compile list; comprehensive compile

definition: point out; show; be a sign or symptom of
example_sentence: Preliminary results indicate that the new treatment is safe and effective.
turkish_translation: Ön sonuçlar yeni tedavinin güvenli ve etkili olduğunu göstermektedir/işaret etmektedir.
collocations: clearly indicate; strongly indicate; results indicate; data indicate

definition: strongly suggest the truth or existence of something not expressly stated
example_sentence: The research findings imply that current educational policies need significant reform.
turkish_translation: Araştırma bulguları mevcut eğitim politikalarının ciddi bir reforma ihtiyacı olduğunu ima etmektedir/göstermektedir.
collocations: strongly imply; imply that; research implies; necessarily imply

definition: cause something to occur in a particular way; be the decisive factor in
example_sentence: Genetics and environment together determine an individual's susceptibility to diseases.
turkish_translation: Genetik ve çevre birlikte bireyin hastalıklara yatkınlığını belirler.
collocations: determine cause; determine factor; accurately determine; predetermine

definition: regard as probable; expect or predict
example_sentence: Economists anticipate a gradual recovery in consumer spending over the coming quarters.
turkish_translation: Ekonomistler önümüzdeki çeyreklerde tüketici harcamalarında kademeli bir toparlanma öngörüyorlar/bekliyorlar.
collocations: anticipate change; eagerly anticipate; anticipate need; anticipate outcome

definition: use or add in place of something else
example_sentence: Researchers attempted to substitute natural plant extracts for synthetic preservatives.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar sentetik koruyucuların yerine doğal bitki özlerini ikame etmeye/kullanmaya çalıştılar.
collocations: substitute for; direct substitute; substitute ingredient; substitute method

definition: act against something in order to reduce its force or neutralize it
example_sentence: Regular exercise can counteract the negative health impacts of a sedentary lifestyle.
turkish_translation: Düzenli egzersiz, hareketsiz bir yaşam tarzının olumsuz sağlık etkilerini nötralize edebilir/karşı koyabilir.
collocations: counteract effect; counteract impact; help counteract; effectively counteract

definition: explain or make something clear by using examples, charts, or diagrams
example_sentence: The case study serves to illustrate how the theoretical model works in practice.
turkish_translation: Vaka çalışması, teorik modelin uygulamada nasıl çalıştığını örneklendirmeye/resmetmeye yarar.
collocations: clearly illustrate; illustrate point; diagram illustrates; serve to illustrate

definition: express an idea or feeling fluently and coherently
example_sentence: Students must be able to articulate their research findings clearly in oral presentations.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler sözlü sunumlarda araştırma bulgularını açıkça ifade edebilmelidir.
collocations: clearly articulate; articulate vision; articulate thought; articulate argument

definition: put forward an idea or plan for consideration or discussion by others
example_sentence: The lead author proposed a new theoretical framework for analyzing language acquisition.
turkish_translation: Başyazar dil edinimini analiz etmek için yeni bir teorik çerçeve önerdi.
collocations: propose theory; propose model; propose solution; propose changes

definition: succeed in achieving something that one desires and has worked for
example_sentence: Students must attain a minimum score of 70% to qualify for advanced courses.
turkish_translation: Öğrencilerin ileri düzey derslere hak kazanabilmeleri için en az %70 puan elde etmeleri/ulaşmaları gerekir.
collocations: attain goal; attain level; attain success; difficult to attain

definition: marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail
example_sentence: Scientific research requires precise measurements to ensure reproducibility.
turkish_translation: Bilimsel araştırma, tekrarlanabilirliği sağlamak için hassas/kesin ölçümler gerektirir.
collocations: precise measurement; precise definition; precise location; extremely precise

definition: of considerable importance, size, or worth
example_sentence: The study revealed a substantial increase in public awareness regarding climate change.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, iklim değişikliğine ilişkin kamuoyu bilincinde önemli/kayda değer bir artış ortaya çıkardı.
collocations: substantial increase; substantial amount; substantial evidence; substantial portion

definition: including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something
example_sentence: The committee published a comprehensive report detailing policy recommendations.
turkish_translation: Komite, politika önerilerini detaylandıran kapsamlı bir rapor yayınladı.
collocations: comprehensive review; comprehensive analysis; comprehensive study; comprehensive overview

definition: absolutely necessary or important; essential
example_sentence: Access to clean water is vital for preventing disease outbreaks in rural areas.
turkish_translation: Temiz suya erişim, kırsal alanlarda hastalık salgınlarını önlemek için hayati önem taşır.
collocations: vital role; vital importance; vital part; vital signs

definition: forming a necessary base or core; of central importance
example_sentence: Freedom of expression is a fundamental right in democratic societies.
turkish_translation: İfade özgürlüğü demokratik toplumlarda temel bir haktır.
collocations: fundamental change; fundamental difference; fundamental principle; fundamental problem

definition: coming after something in time; following
example_sentence: Subsequent studies confirmed the findings of the initial trial.
turkish_translation: Sonraki/müteakip çalışmalar ilk denemenin bulgularını doğruladı.
collocations: subsequent research; subsequent analysis; subsequent years; subsequent events

definition: so delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe
example_sentence: There are subtle differences between the two linguistic dialects.
turkish_translation: İki dilsel lehçe arasında ince/ince elenmiş farklılıklar var.
collocations: subtle distinction; subtle difference; subtle shift; subtle change

definition: certain to happen; unavoidable
example_sentence: Technological disruption is an inevitable consequence of rapid innovation.
turkish_translation: Teknolojik yıkım, hızlı yeniliğin kaçınılmaz bir sonucudur.
collocations: inevitable result; inevitable consequence; virtually inevitable; seem inevitable

definition: clearly visible or understood; obvious
example_sentence: It became apparent that the initial hypothesis was incorrect.
turkish_translation: İlk hipotezin yanlış olduğu aşikâr/açık hale geldi.
collocations: apparent reason; become apparent; clearly apparent; readily apparent

definition: satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity
example_sentence: The study failed to provide adequate evidence to support the claims.
turkish_translation: Çalışma iddiaları desteklemek için yeterli/uygun kanıt sağlayamadı.
collocations: adequate resources; adequate protection; adequate information; adequate funding

definition: present as the strongest or main element
example_sentence: Agriculture remains the predominant sector in the regional economy.
turkish_translation: Tarım, bölgesel ekonomide baskın/ağırlıklı sektör olmaya devam ediyor.
collocations: predominant factor; predominant culture; predominant cause; predominant role

definition: equal in value, amount, function, meaning, etc.
example_sentence: The two qualification certificates are considered legally equivalent.
turkish_translation: İki yeterlilik belgesi yasal olarak eşdeğer kabul edilir.
collocations: roughly equivalent; functional equivalent; equivalent to; moral equivalent

definition: corresponding in size or amount to something else
example_sentence: Tax rates should be proportional to individual income levels.
turkish_translation: Vergi oranları bireysel gelir düzeyleriyle orantılı olmalıdır.
collocations: directly proportional; inversely proportional; proportional representation; strictly proportional

definition: acting or done in the same way over time, especially so as to be fair or accurate; in agreement
example_sentence: The empirical findings are consistent with previous academic studies.
turkish_translation: Empirik bulgular önceki akademik çalışmalarla tutarlıdır.
collocations: consistent with; highly consistent; consistent results; internal consistency

definition: decisive or critical, especially in the success or failure of something
example_sentence: Early intervention plays a crucial role in managing developmental disorders.
turkish_translation: Erken müdahale, gelişimsel bozuklukların yönetiminde çok önemli/kritik bir rol oynar.
collocations: crucial role; crucial factor; crucial importance; crucial element

definition: very great or intense; having or showing great knowledge or insight
example_sentence: The industrial revolution had a profound impact on social structure.
turkish_translation: Sanayi devriminin toplumsal yapı üzerinde derin bir etkisi oldu.
collocations: profound impact; profound effect; profound influence; profound change

definition: of or situated on the inside
example_sentence: The audit examined the company's internal control mechanisms.
turkish_translation: Denetimde şirketin iç kontrol mekanizmaları incelendi.
collocations: internal consistency; internal structure; internal audit; internal market

definition: belonging to or forming the outer surface or structure of something
example_sentence: External validation of the predictive model was performed using a new dataset.
turkish_translation: Tahmin modelinin dış doğrulaması yeni bir veri kümesi kullanılarak gerçekleştirilmiştir.
collocations: external factor; external validity; external source; external environment

definition: existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute
example_sentence: There are inherent risks involved in financial market speculation.
turkish_translation: Finansal piyasa spekülasyonunda özünde var olan/doğal riskler bulunmaktadır.
collocations: inherent risk; inherent danger; inherent quality; inherent limitation

definition: performed or occurring as a result of a sudden impulse or inclination and without premeditation
example_sentence: Spontaneous recovery occurred in a small percentage of experimental subjects.
turkish_translation: Deneysel deneklerin küçük bir yüzdesinde kendiliğinden/kendiliğinden oluşan bir iyileşme meydana geldi.
collocations: spontaneous recovery; spontaneous reaction; spontaneous speech; spontaneous emission

definition: relating to cognition or mental processes of perception, memory, and judgment
example_sentence: Cognitive decline is often associated with aging and neurodegenerative conditions.
turkish_translation: Bilişsel gerileme genellikle yaşlanma ve nörodejeneratif durumlarla ilişkilendirilir.

example_sentence: Coastal regions are particularly vulnerable to climate change-induced sea level rise.
turkish_translation: Kıyı bölgeleri, iklim değişikliğinin neden olduğu deniz seviyesi artışına karşı özellikle hassastır/savunmasızdır.
collocations: vulnerable species; vulnerable population; highly vulnerable; vulnerable to

definition: a general agreement among a group of people
example_sentence: Scientific consensus agrees that global temperatures are rising due to human activity.
turkish_translation: Bilimsel konsensüs/uzlaşı, küresel sıcaklıkların insan faaliyetleri nedeniyle yükseldiği konusunda hemfikirdir.
collocations: reach consensus; scientific consensus; general consensus; consensus building

definition: the official procedure or system of rules governing affairs of state or diplomatic occasions
example_sentence: Researchers must strictly adhere to ethical protocol when working with human subjects.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar, insan deneklerle çalışırken etik protokole harfiyen uymalıdır.
collocations: experimental protocol; safety protocol; medical protocol; follow protocol

definition: publicly recommend or support a particular cause or policy
example_sentence: Environmental scientists advocate for immediate policy changes regarding fossil fuel usage.
turkish_translation: Çevre bilimcileri, fosil yakıt kullanımına ilişkin derhal politika değişiklikleri yapılmasını savunmaktadır.
collocations: advocate change; strongly advocate; advocate rights; advocate use

definition: act in accordance with a wish or command
example_sentence: All manufacturing facilities must comply with international environmental regulations.
turkish_translation: Tüm üretim tesisleri uluslararası çevre düzenlemelerine uymak zorundadır.
collocations: comply with; strictly comply; comply with regulations; fail to comply

definition: including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something
example_sentence: The ministry published a comprehensive report on national educational development.
turkish_translation: Bakanlık, ulusal eğitim gelişimi hakkında kapsamlı bir rapor yayınladı.
collocations: comprehensive study; comprehensive review; comprehensive plan; comprehensive analysis

definition: rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
example_sentence: Global commodity prices fluctuate based on supply chain stability and geopolitics.
turkish_translation: Küresel emtia fiyatları, tedarik zinciri istikrarı ve jeopolitiğe bağlı olarak dalgalanır.
collocations: fluctuate wildly; prices fluctuate; temperature fluctuates; constantly fluctuate

definition: give someone something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury
example_sentence: The system automatically adjusts engine power to compensate for drag forces.
turkish_translation: Sistem, sürükleme kuvvetlerini telafi etmek için motor gücünü otomatik olarak ayarlar.
collocations: compensate for; fully compensate; compensate loss; financially compensate

definition: consider or use one thing as a balance against another side or aspect
example_sentence: Companies invest in renewable energy to offset their carbon emissions footprints.
turkish_translation: Şirketler, karbon emisyonu ayak izlerini dengelemek/telafi etmek için yenilenebilir enerjiye yatırım yapmaktadır.
collocations: offset emissions; partially offset; offset costs; offset risk

definition: succeed in persuading or influencing someone to do something; bring about or give rise to
example_sentence: High stress levels can induce cardiovascular complications over time.
turkish_translation: Yüksek stres seviyeleri zamanla kardiyovasküler komplikasyonları tetikleyebilir/oluşturabilir.
collocations: induce response; induce change; artificial induce; induce panic

definition: completely remove or get rid of something
example_sentence: Vaccination campaigns aim to eliminate infectious diseases globally.
turkish_translation: Aşılama kampanyaları, bulaşıcı hastalıkları küresel olarak ortadan kaldırmayı amaçlamaktadır.
collocations: eliminate risk; completely eliminate; eliminate waste; eliminate need

definition: combine one thing with another so that they become a whole
example_sentence: Modern curricula integrate digital literacy skills into traditional subjects.
turkish_translation: Modern müfredatlar, dijital okuryazarlık becerilerini geleneksel derslere entegre etmektedir.
collocations: integrate into; fully integrate; integrate technology; integrate systems

definition: pull or twist out of shape; give a misleading or false account or impression of

turkish_translation: Yanlı/seçici örnekleme, istatistiksel anket sonuçlarını önemli ölçüde saptırabilir/bozabilir.
collocations: distort truth; distort reality; distort image; distort facts

definition: handle or control a tool or mechanism in a skillful manner; alter data skillfully or unfairly
example_sentence: Researchers can manipulate experimental variables to observe corresponding reactions.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar, karşılık gelen reaksiyonları gözlemlemek için deneysel değişkenleri yönlendirebilir/işleyebilirler.
collocations: manipulate data; manipulate variables; genetic manipulation; skillfully manipulate

definition: remove or take out, especially by effort or force
example_sentence: Biologists extract RNA from cellular samples for molecular sequencing.
turkish_translation: Biyologlar, moleküler dizileme için hücresel örneklerden RNA çıkarırlar/özütlerler.
collocations: extract data; extract DNA; extract information; chemical extract

definition: make an action or process easy or easier
example_sentence: Collaborative online platforms facilitate knowledge sharing among global scholars.
turkish_translation: İşbirlikçi çevrimiçi platformlar, küresel akademisyenler arasında bilgi paylaşımını kolaylaştırır.
collocations: facilitate learning; facilitate process; greatly facilitate; facilitate communication

definition: belonging naturally; essential
example_sentence: Curiosity is an intrinsic motivation for scientific discovery and lifelong learning.
turkish_translation: Merak, bilimsel keşif ve yaşam boyu öğrenme için içsel bir motivasyondur.
collocations: intrinsic value; intrinsic motivation; intrinsic property; intrinsic quality

definition: not part of the essential nature of someone or something; coming or operating from outside
example_sentence: Financial rewards are extrinsic motivators that can influence short-term employee behavior.
turkish_translation: Finansal ödüller, kısa vadeli çalışan davranışını etkileyebilecek dışsal motivasyon faktörleridir.
collocations: extrinsic motivation; extrinsic factor; extrinsic rewards; extrinsic value

definition: based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory
example_sentence: The study provides strong empirical support for the new therapeutic method.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, yeni terapötik yöntem için güçlü ampirik destek sağlamaktadır.
collocations: empirical evidence; empirical data; empirical research; empirical study

definition: based on or serving as a hypothesis; supposed but not necessarily true

turkish_translation: Ekip, ekonomik kriz senaryolarını değerlendirmek için varsayımsal bir model oluşturdu.
collocations: hypothetical scenario; hypothetical situation; purely hypothetical; hypothetical example

definition: concerned with or involving the theory of a subject rather than practical application
example_sentence: Theoretical physics explores fundamental laws governing the universe.
turkish_translation: Teorik fizik, evreni yöneten temel yasaları araştırır.
collocations: theoretical framework; theoretical model; theoretical physics; theoretical foundation

definition: based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system
example_sentence: Setting an arbitrary cutoff score without empirical backing can bias the evaluation.
turkish_translation: Empirik destek olmadan keyfi bir baraj puanı belirlemek değerlendirmeyi yanlı hale getirebilir.
collocations: arbitrary decision; arbitrary rule; arbitrary choice; completely arbitrary

definition: having power and influence over others; most important, powerful, or influential
example_sentence: English has become the dominant language of global academic communication.
turkish_translation: İngilizce, küresel akademik iletişimin baskın dili haline gelmiştir.
collocations: dominant role; dominant culture; dominant allele; dominant gene

definition: so delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe
example_sentence: Researchers detected subtle shifts in patient brain activity during memory tasks.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar, hafıza görevleri sırasında hasta beyin aktivitesinde ince/hafif değişimler tespit ettiler.
collocations: subtle difference; subtle shift; subtle distinction; subtle change

definition: stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt

turkish_translation: Politika, araştırma verisi paylaşım protokollerine ilişkin açık/net yönergeler sunmaktadır.

turkish_translation: Ekip üyeleri arasında iş yükü dağılımına ilişkin örtük bir anlaşma vardı.

definition: a wide range of related qualities, ideas, or scientific phenomena

turkish_translation: Çalışma, sağlığı etkileyen geniş bir sosyoekonomik faktörler spektrumunu/yelpazesini analiz etti.
collocations: broad spectrum; electromagnetic spectrum; autism spectrum; political spectrum

definition: a typical example or pattern of something; a model or overarching framework
example_sentence: Quantum mechanics introduced a major paradigm shift in modern physics.
turkish_translation: Kuantum mekaniği, modern fizikte büyük bir paradigma değişimi başlattı.
collocations: paradigm shift; new paradigm; dominant paradigm; paradigm change

definition: a system in which members of an organization or society are ranked according to status

turkish_translation: Maslow'un ihtiyaçlar hiyerarşisi insan motivasyonunu belirgin seviyelere ayırır.
collocations: social hierarchy; organizational hierarchy; hierarchy of needs; rigid hierarchy

definition: the relative position or direction of something; focus or inclination

turkish_translation: Araştırma programı, endüstri problemlerine yönelik güçlü ve pratik bir odağa/yönelim tutumuna sahiptir.
collocations: spatial orientation; market orientation; theoretical orientation; goal orientation

definition: a system of ideas and ideals forming the basis of economic or political theory
example_sentence: Political ideology shapes national policy priorities regarding public health spending.
turkish_translation: Siyasi ideoloji, kamu sağlığı harcamalarına ilişkin ulusal politika önceliklerini şekillendirir.
collocations: political ideology; dominant ideology; ideological conflict; underlying ideology

definition: the basic physical and organizational structures and facilities needed for operation

definition: a basic structure underlying a system, concept, or text

turkish_translation: Yazarlar, kentsel hareketlilik kalıplarını incelemek için analitik bir çerçeve önerdiler.
collocations: theoretical framework; conceptual framework; regulatory framework; policy framework

definition: a part, share, or number considered in comparative relation to a whole

collocations: large proportion; direct proportion; inverse proportion; significant proportion

definition: a measurable extent of some kind; an aspect or feature of a situation

definition: the great size or extent of something; numerical quantity

turkish_translation: Çevresel hasarın gerçek büyüklüğü araştırmadan sonra netleşti.

definition: a combination of statements, ideas, or features of a situation that are opposed to one another

definition: the state of coming together from different directions to form a common result

turkish_translation: Başarılı yazılım entegrasyonu, dikkatli planlama ve standart protokoller gerektirir.

turkish_translation: Erken davranışsal müdahale, çocuklarda gelişimsel seyri önemli ölçüde iyileştirebilir.

turkish_translation: Evrimsel adaptasyon/uyum, organizmaların özelleşmiş nişlerde gelişmesini sağlar.

definition: the gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a complex form
example_sentence: The evolution of computer programming languages spans several decades.
turkish_translation: Bilgisayar programlama dillerinin evrimi/gelişimi birkaç on yılı kapsamaktadır.

definition: the action of making changes to something; an alteration

turkish_translation: Küçük yazılım değişiklikleri/modifikasyonları sistem güvenlik açıklarını çözdü.

definition: the way something is spread out or arranged over an area or among a group
example_sentence: The normal distribution curve is a foundational concept in inferential statistics.
turkish_translation: Normal dağılım eğrisi, çıkarımsal istatistiğin temel bir kavramıdır.

definition: the action or process of distributing resources or duties for a specific purpose

turkish_translation: Etkin kaynak tahsisi/dağıtımı, dar bütçeler altında proje başarısının anahtarıdır.

example_sentence: Thermal efficiency of the solar engine was measured under laboratory conditions.
turkish_translation: Güneş motorunun termal verimliliği laboratuvar koşullarında ölçülmüştür.

turkish_translation: Yapı geçerliliği, bir testin ölçmeyi amaçladığı spesifik kavramı ölçüp ölçmediğini belirler.

definition: the quality of being trustworthy or performing consistently well
example_sentence: High test-retest reliability is essential for diagnostic assessment instruments.
turkish_translation: Yüksek test-yeniden test güvenilirliği, tanısal değerlendirme araçları için esastır.

example_sentence: Probability theory provides tools for evaluating risk in uncertain environments.
turkish_translation: Olasılık teorisi, belirsiz ortamlarda riski değerlendirmek için araçlar sağlar.

definition: the rate at which something occurs or is repeated over a period of time
example_sentence: High-frequency trading algorithms execute stock transactions in milliseconds.
turkish_translation: Yüksek frekanslı ticaret algoritmaları milisaniyeler içinde hisse senedi işlemlerini gerçekleştirir.

definition: the quality of being intense; measurable strength or magnitude
example_sentence: The intensity of the magnetic field was adjusted during the resonance scan.
turkish_translation: Resonans taraması sırasında manyetik alanın yoğunluğu/şiddeti ayarlanmıştır.

definition: the degree of compactness of a substance; mass per unit volume
example_sentence: Bone mineral density tests are used to diagnose osteoporosis in aging adults.
turkish_translation: Kemik mineral yoğunluğu testleri yaşlanan yetişkinlerde osteoporozu teşhis etmek için kullanılır.

definition: the maximum amount that something can contain or produce; capability

turkish_translation: Zihinsel depolama kapasitesi, çocukluk gelişim evrelerinde önemli ölçüde artar.

definition: a point of entry or a minimum level that must be reached for an effect to occur
example_sentence: Sensory threshold levels vary across individuals depending on biological factors.
turkish_translation: Duyusal eşik seviyeleri, biyolojik faktörlere bağlı olarak bireyler arasında değişiklik gösterir.
collocations: pain threshold; statistical threshold; critical threshold; detection threshold

definition: a numerical or measurable factor defining a system or conditions of operation
example_sentence: Engineers adjusted input parameters to optimize combustion efficiency.
turkish_translation: Mühendisler yanma verimliliğini optimize etmek için girdi parametrelerini ayarladılar.

definition: an indicator, sign, or measure of something

turkish_translation: İnsani gelişme endeksi eğitim, gelir ve ortalama yaşam süresi ölçütlerini birleştirir.

definition: a thing that indicates the state or level of something

turkish_translation: Su berraklığı, gölün ekolojik sağlığının güvenilir bir göstergesidir.

definition: an object, gene, or feature that identifies a condition, location, or entity

definition: a useful or valuable quality, person, or thing; property
example_sentence: Intellectual property is a key corporate asset in high-tech industries.
turkish_translation: Fikri mülkiyet, yüksek teknoloji endüstrilerinde temel bir kurumsal varlıktır/değerdir.

definition: a supply of money, materials, staff, or assets that can be drawn on

turkish_translation: Sürdürülebilir kalkınma için verimli kaynak yönetimi esastır.

definition: the amount by which something is too small or falls short

definition: an amount of something left over when requirements have been met; excess

definition: the amount of something produced by a system, machine, or individual

definition: the way a thing turns out; a consequence or result

turkish_translation: Yeni tedavi protokolü altında hasta sağlık sonuçları önemli ölçüde iyileşmiştir.

definition: the combination of ideas, elements, or compounds to form a complex whole

turkish_translation: Literatür taraması, çeşitli araştırma bulgularının eleştirel bir sentezini gerektirir.

definition: detailed examination of the elements or structure of something

turkish_translation: Nicel veri analizi, istatistiksel yazılım paketleri kullanılarak gerçekleştirilmiştir.

definition: the making of a judgment about the value, quality, or magnitude of something

turkish_translation: Sıkı akran değerlendirmesi, bilimsel yayıncılıkta yüksek standartları garanti eder.

definition: the action of putting something into operation; practical use

definition: the ability to see, hear, or become aware of something through the senses; interpretation

definition: the continued possession, use, or control of something; ability to remember
