definition: including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something
example_sentence: The ministry published a comprehensive report on national educational development.
turkish_translation: Bakanlık, ulusal eğitim gelişimi hakkında kapsamlı bir rapor yayınladı.
collocations: comprehensive study; comprehensive review; comprehensive plan; comprehensive analysis

definition: rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
example_sentence: Global commodity prices fluctuate based on supply chain stability and geopolitics.
turkish_translation: Küresel emtia fiyatları, tedarik zinciri istikrarı ve jeopolitiğe bağlı olarak dalgalanır.
collocations: fluctuate wildly; prices fluctuate; temperature fluctuates; constantly fluctuate

definition: give someone something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury
example_sentence: The system automatically adjusts engine power to compensate for drag forces.
turkish_translation: Sistem, sürükleme kuvvetlerini telafi etmek için motor gücünü otomatik olarak ayarlar.
collocations: compensate for; fully compensate; compensate loss; financially compensate

definition: consider or use one thing as a balance against another side or aspect
example_sentence: Companies invest in renewable energy to offset their carbon emissions footprints.
turkish_translation: Şirketler, karbon emisyonu ayak izlerini dengelemek/telafi etmek için yenilenebilir enerjiye yatırım yapmaktadır.
collocations: offset emissions; partially offset; offset costs; offset risk

definition: succeed in persuading or influencing someone to do something; bring about or give rise to
example_sentence: High stress levels can induce cardiovascular complications over time.
turkish_translation: Yüksek stres seviyeleri zamanla kardiyovasküler komplikasyonları tetikleyebilir/oluşturabilir.
collocations: induce response; induce change; artificial induce; induce panic

definition: completely remove or get rid of something
example_sentence: Vaccination campaigns aim to eliminate infectious diseases globally.
turkish_translation: Aşılama kampanyaları, bulaşıcı hastalıkları küresel olarak ortadan kaldırmayı amaçlamaktadır.
collocations: eliminate risk; completely eliminate; eliminate waste; eliminate need

definition: combine one thing with another so that they become a whole
example_sentence: Modern curricula integrate digital literacy skills into traditional subjects.
turkish_translation: Modern müfredatlar, dijital okuryazarlık becerilerini geleneksel derslere entegre etmektedir.
collocations: integrate into; fully integrate; integrate technology; integrate systems

definition: pull or twist out of shape; give a misleading or false account or impression of
example_sentence: Selective sampling can distort statistical survey results significantly.
turkish_translation: Yanlı/seçici örnekleme, istatistiksel anket sonuçlarını önemli ölçüde saptırabilir/bozabilir.
collocations: distort truth; distort reality; distort image; distort facts

definition: handle or control a tool or mechanism in a skillful manner; alter data skillfully or unfairly
example_sentence: Researchers can manipulate experimental variables to observe corresponding reactions.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar, karşılık gelen reaksiyonları gözlemlemek için deneysel değişkenleri yönlendirebilir/işleyebilirler.
collocations: manipulate data; manipulate variables; genetic manipulation; skillfully manipulate

definition: remove or take out, especially by effort or force
example_sentence: Biologists extract RNA from cellular samples for molecular sequencing.
turkish_translation: Biyologlar, moleküler dizileme için hücresel örneklerden RNA çıkarırlar/özütlerler.
collocations: extract data; extract DNA; extract information; chemical extract

definition: make an action or process easy or easier
example_sentence: Collaborative online platforms facilitate knowledge sharing among global scholars.
turkish_translation: İşbirlikçi çevrimiçi platformlar, küresel akademisyenler arasında bilgi paylaşımını kolaylaştırır.
collocations: facilitate learning; facilitate process; greatly facilitate; facilitate communication

definition: belonging naturally; essential
example_sentence: Curiosity is an intrinsic motivation for scientific discovery and lifelong learning.
turkish_translation: Merak, bilimsel keşif ve yaşam boyu öğrenme için içsel bir motivasyondur.
collocations: intrinsic value; intrinsic motivation; intrinsic property; intrinsic quality

definition: not part of the essential nature of someone or something; coming or operating from outside
example_sentence: Financial rewards are extrinsic motivators that can influence short-term employee behavior.
turkish_translation: Finansal ödüller, kısa vadeli çalışan davranışını etkileyebilecek dışsal motivasyon faktörleridir.
collocations: extrinsic motivation; extrinsic factor; extrinsic rewards; extrinsic value

definition: based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory
example_sentence: The study provides strong empirical support for the new therapeutic method.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, yeni terapötik yöntem için güçlü ampirik destek sağlamaktadır.
collocations: empirical evidence; empirical data; empirical research; empirical study

definition: based on or serving as a hypothesis; supposed but not necessarily true
example_sentence: The team constructed a hypothetical model to evaluate economic crisis scenarios.
turkish_translation: Ekip, ekonomik kriz senaryolarını değerlendirmek için varsayımsal bir model oluşturdu.
collocations: hypothetical scenario; hypothetical situation; purely hypothetical; hypothetical example

definition: concerned with or involving the theory of a subject rather than practical application
example_sentence: Theoretical physics explores fundamental laws governing the universe.
turkish_translation: Teorik fizik, evreni yöneten temel yasaları araştırır.
collocations: theoretical framework; theoretical model; theoretical physics; theoretical foundation

definition: based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system
example_sentence: Setting an arbitrary cutoff score without empirical backing can bias the evaluation.
turkish_translation: Empirik destek olmadan keyfi bir baraj puanı belirlemek değerlendirmeyi yanlı hale getirebilir.
collocations: arbitrary decision; arbitrary rule; arbitrary choice; completely arbitrary

definition: having power and influence over others; most important, powerful, or influential
example_sentence: English has become the dominant language of global academic communication.
turkish_translation: İngilizce, küresel akademik iletişimin baskın dili haline gelmiştir.
collocations: dominant role; dominant culture; dominant allele; dominant gene

definition: so delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe
example_sentence: Researchers detected subtle shifts in patient brain activity during memory tasks.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar, hafıza görevleri sırasında hasta beyin aktivitesinde ince/hafif değişimler tespit ettiler.
collocations: subtle difference; subtle shift; subtle distinction; subtle change

definition: stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt
example_sentence: The policy provides explicit guidelines regarding research data sharing protocols.
turkish_translation: Politika, araştırma verisi paylaşım protokollerine ilişkin açık/net yönergeler sunmaktadır.
collocations: explicit instructions; explicit policy; explicit consent; explicit statement

definition: suggested though not directly expressed
example_sentence: There was an implicit agreement among team members regarding workload distribution.
turkish_translation: Ekip üyeleri arasında iş yükü dağılımına ilişkin örtük bir anlaşma vardı.
collocations: implicit bias; implicit knowledge; implicit meaning; implicit assumption

definition: a wide range of related qualities, ideas, or scientific phenomena
example_sentence: The study analyzed a broad spectrum of socioeconomic factors affecting health.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, sağlığı etkileyen geniş bir sosyoekonomik faktörler spektrumunu/yelpazesini analiz etti.
collocations: broad spectrum; electromagnetic spectrum; autism spectrum; political spectrum

definition: a typical example or pattern of something; a model or overarching framework
example_sentence: Quantum mechanics introduced a major paradigm shift in modern physics.
turkish_translation: Kuantum mekaniği, modern fizikte büyük bir paradigma değişimi başlattı.
collocations: paradigm shift; new paradigm; dominant paradigm; paradigm change

definition: a system in which members of an organization or society are ranked according to status
example_sentence: Maslow's hierarchy of needs categorizes human motivation into distinct levels.
turkish_translation: Maslow'un ihtiyaçlar hiyerarşisi insan motivasyonunu belirgin seviyelere ayırır.
collocations: social hierarchy; organizational hierarchy; hierarchy of needs; rigid hierarchy

definition: the relative position or direction of something; focus or inclination
example_sentence: The research program maintains a strong practical orientation towards industry problems.
turkish_translation: Araştırma programı, endüstri problemlerine yönelik güçlü ve pratik bir odağa/yönelim tutumuna sahiptir.
collocations: spatial orientation; market orientation; theoretical orientation; goal orientation

definition: a system of ideas and ideals forming the basis of economic or political theory
example_sentence: Political ideology shapes national policy priorities regarding public health spending.
turkish_translation: Siyasi ideoloji, kamu sağlığı harcamalarına ilişkin ulusal politika önceliklerini şekillendirir.
collocations: political ideology; dominant ideology; ideological conflict; underlying ideology

definition: the basic physical and organizational structures and facilities needed for operation
example_sentence: Investment in digital infrastructure is vital for modern economic growth.
turkish_translation: Dijital altyapıya yatırım yapmak modern ekonomik büyüme için hayati önem taşımaktadır.
collocations: digital infrastructure; critical infrastructure; transport infrastructure; infrastructure investment

definition: a basic structure underlying a system, concept, or text
example_sentence: The authors proposed an analytical framework for studying urban mobility patterns.
turkish_translation: Yazarlar, kentsel hareketlilik kalıplarını incelemek için analitik bir çerçeve önerdiler.
collocations: theoretical framework; conceptual framework; regulatory framework; policy framework

definition: a part, share, or number considered in comparative relation to a whole
example_sentence: A high proportion of renewable energy in the grid improves energy security.
turkish_translation: Sebekedeki yüksek orandaki yenilenebilir enerji, enerji güvenliğini artırır.
collocations: large proportion; direct proportion; inverse proportion; significant proportion

definition: a measurable extent of some kind; an aspect or feature of a situation
example_sentence: The crisis added an ethical dimension to corporate governance discussions.
turkish_translation: Kriz, kurumsal yönetim tartışmalarına etik bir boyut kattı.
collocations: spatial dimension; ethical dimension; new dimension; key dimension

definition: the great size or extent of something; numerical quantity
example_sentence: The true magnitude of environmental damage became clear after the survey.
turkish_translation: Çevresel hasarın gerçek büyüklüğü araştırmadan sonra netleşti.
collocations: order of magnitude; magnitude of problem; earthquake magnitude; sheer magnitude

definition: a confident and forceful statement of fact or belief
example_sentence: The study challenges the assertion that economic growth automatically reduces poverty.
turkish_translation: Çalışma, ekonomik büyümenin yoksulluğu otomatik olarak azalttığı iddiasına/savına meydan okumaktadır.
collocations: make an assertion; bold assertion; challenge assertion; empirical assertion

definition: a statement or assertion that expresses a judgment or opinion
example_sentence: The research rests on the proposition that early language learning shapes cognitive growth.
turkish_translation: Araştırma, erken dil öğreniminin bilişsel gelişimi şekillendirdiği önermesine dayanmaktadır.
collocations: test a proposition; theoretical proposition; basic proposition; research proposition

definition: a proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation
example_sentence: The empirical data strongly supported the initial research hypothesis.
turkish_translation: Empirik veriler, ilk araştırma hipotezini güçlü bir şekilde destekledi.
collocations: null hypothesis; test a hypothesis; confirm hypothesis; form a hypothesis

definition: a previous statement or proposition from which another is inferred or follows as a conclusion
example_sentence: If the underlying premise is flawed, the entire logical argument collapses.
turkish_translation: Temeldeki öncül kusurluysa, tüm mantıksal argüman çöker.
collocations: basic premise; false premise; underlying premise; starting premise

definition: a conclusion that can be drawn from something although it is not explicitly stated
example_sentence: The findings have significant implications for future clinical trial designs.
turkish_translation: Bulguların gelecekteki klinik deney tasarımları açısından önemli olası sonuçları/iması bulunmaktadır.
collocations: policy implications; practical implications; serious implications; broader implications

definition: a combination of statements, ideas, or features of a situation that are opposed to one another
example_sentence: There is a clear contradiction between the two survey data sets.
turkish_translation: İki anket veri kümesi arasında net bir çelişki vardır.
collocations: direct contradiction; internal contradiction; apparent contradiction; in contradiction to

definition: a lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts
example_sentence: Engineers discovered a minor discrepancy between measured and predicted stress values.
turkish_translation: Mühendisler, ölçülen ve tahmin edilen stres değerleri arasında küçük bir uyumsuzluk/tutarsızlık keşfettiler.
collocations: discrepancy between; major discrepancy; explain discrepancy; resolve discrepancy

definition: a change or difference in condition, amount, or level
example_sentence: Seasonal variation in rainfall affects crop yield across agricultural zones.
turkish_translation: Yağıştaki mevsimsel varyasyon/değişim, tarım bölgelerindeki ürün rekoltesini etkiler.
collocations: genetic variation; seasonal variation; regional variation; wide variation

definition: a drawing apart from a common point; difference or conflict
example_sentence: A divergence in methodology led to contrasting research outcomes between laboratories.
turkish_translation: Metodolojideki bir ayrışma/ıraksama, laboratuvarlar arasında zıt araştırma sonuçlarına yol açtı.
collocations: growing divergence; divergence of views; divergence from; path divergence

definition: the state of coming together from different directions to form a common result
example_sentence: The convergence of technological innovations spurred a new industrial era.
turkish_translation: Teknolojik yeniliklerin yakınlaşması/birleşmesi yeni bir sanayi çağını tetikledi.
collocations: point of convergence; technological convergence; media convergence; economic convergence

definition: reciprocal action, effect, or influence between two or more things
example_sentence: Gene-environment interaction determines an organism's observable physical traits.
turkish_translation: Gen-çevre etkileşimi bir organizmanın gözlemlenebilir fiziksel özelliklerini belirler.
collocations: social interaction; direct interaction; interaction between; human interaction

definition: the action or process of combining things into an integral whole
example_sentence: Successful software integration requires careful planning and standard protocols.
turkish_translation: Başarılı yazılım entegrasyonu, dikkatli planlama ve standart protokoller gerektirir.
collocations: system integration; economic integration; social integration; seamless integration

definition: action taken to improve a situation or prevent its deterioration
example_sentence: Early behavioral intervention can significantly improve developmental trajectory in children.
turkish_translation: Erken davranışsal müdahale, çocuklarda gelişimsel seyri önemli ölçüde iyileştirebilir.
collocations: early intervention; medical intervention; government intervention; surgical intervention

definition: a thorough or dramatic change in form, structure, or appearance
example_sentence: The energy transition represents a major technological transformation.
turkish_translation: Enerji dönüşümü büyük bir teknolojik dönüşümü temsil eder.
collocations: digital transformation; social transformation; transformation process; complete transformation

definition: the process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another
example_sentence: The transition from student to professional requires acquiring new skill sets.
turkish_translation: Öğrencilikten profesyonelliğe geçiş, yeni beceri setleri edinmeyi gerektirir.
collocations: smooth transition; transition period; transition to; phase transition

definition: the process of changing to suit new conditions or environment
example_sentence: Evolutionary adaptation enables organisms to thrive in specialized niches.
turkish_translation: Evrimsel adaptasyon/uyum, organizmaların özelleşmiş nişlerde gelişmesini sağlar.
collocations: climate adaptation; biological adaptation; adaptation strategy; cultural adaptation

definition: the gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a complex form
example_sentence: The evolution of computer programming languages spans several decades.
turkish_translation: Bilgisayar programlama dillerinin evrimi/gelişimi birkaç on yılı kapsamaktadır.
collocations: human evolution; theory of evolution; gradual evolution; evolutionary biology

definition: the action of making changes to something; an alteration
example_sentence: Minor software modifications resolved the system security vulnerabilities.
turkish_translation: Küçük yazılım değişiklikleri/modifikasyonları sistem güvenlik açıklarını çözdü.
collocations: genetic modification; behavior modification; structural modification; design modification

definition: the way something is spread out or arranged over an area or among a group
example_sentence: The normal distribution curve is a foundational concept in inferential statistics.
turkish_translation: Normal dağılım eğrisi, çıkarımsal istatistiğin temel bir kavramıdır.
collocations: normal distribution; spatial distribution; income distribution; frequency distribution

definition: the action or process of distributing resources or duties for a specific purpose
example_sentence: Efficient resource allocation is key to project success under tight budgets.
turkish_translation: Etkin kaynak tahsisi/dağıtımı, dar bütçeler altında proje başarısının anahtarıdır.
collocations: resource allocation; budget allocation; asset allocation; optimal allocation

definition: the state or quality of achieving maximum output with minimum wasted effort
example_sentence: Thermal efficiency of the solar engine was measured under laboratory conditions.
turkish_translation: Güneş motorunun termal verimliliği laboratuvar koşullarında ölçülmüştür.
collocations: energy efficiency; operational efficiency; high efficiency; improve efficiency

definition: the quality of being logically or factually sound
example_sentence: Construct validity determines whether a test measures the specific concept it intends to.
turkish_translation: Yapı geçerliliği, bir testin ölçmeyi amaçladığı spesifik kavramı ölçüp ölçmediğini belirler.
collocations: construct validity; external validity; internal validity; question validity

definition: the quality of being trustworthy or performing consistently well
example_sentence: High test-retest reliability is essential for diagnostic assessment instruments.
turkish_translation: Yüksek test-yeniden test güvenilirliği, tanısal değerlendirme araçları için esastır.
collocations: high reliability; system reliability; test reliability; ensure reliability

definition: the extent to which an event is likely to occur
example_sentence: Probability theory provides tools for evaluating risk in uncertain environments.
turkish_translation: Olasılık teorisi, belirsiz ortamlarda riski değerlendirmek için araçlar sağlar.
collocations: probability theory; high probability; conditional probability; low probability

definition: the rate at which something occurs or is repeated over a period of time
example_sentence: High-frequency trading algorithms execute stock transactions in milliseconds.
turkish_translation: Yüksek frekanslı ticaret algoritmaları milisaniyeler içinde hisse senedi işlemlerini gerçekleştirir.
collocations: high frequency; relative frequency; pulse frequency; allele frequency

definition: the quality of being intense; measurable strength or magnitude
example_sentence: The intensity of the magnetic field was adjusted during the resonance scan.
turkish_translation: Resonans taraması sırasında manyetik alanın yoğunluğu/şiddeti ayarlanmıştır.
collocations: light intensity; signal intensity; exercise intensity; high intensity

definition: the degree of compactness of a substance; mass per unit volume
example_sentence: Bone mineral density tests are used to diagnose osteoporosis in aging adults.
turkish_translation: Kemik mineral yoğunluğu testleri yaşlanan yetişkinlerde osteoporozu teşhis etmek için kullanılır.
collocations: bone density; population density; high density; energy density

definition: the speed of something in a given direction
example_sentence: Fluid velocity within the pipe was measured using acoustic Doppler instrumentation.
turkish_translation: Boru içindeki akışkan hızı, akustik Doppler ekipmanı kullanılarak ölçülmüştür.
collocations: fluid velocity; initial velocity; terminal velocity; velocity vector

definition: the maximum amount that something can contain or produce; capability
example_sentence: Mental storage capacity increases substantially during child development stages.
turkish_translation: Zihinsel depolama kapasitesi, çocukluk gelişim evrelerinde önemli ölçüde artar.
collocations: full capacity; building capacity; cognitive capacity; maximum capacity

definition: a point of entry or a minimum level that must be reached for an effect to occur
example_sentence: Sensory threshold levels vary across individuals depending on biological factors.
turkish_translation: Duyusal eşik seviyeleri, biyolojik faktörlere bağlı olarak bireyler arasında değişiklik gösterir.
collocations: pain threshold; statistical threshold; critical threshold; detection threshold

definition: a numerical or measurable factor defining a system or conditions of operation
example_sentence: Engineers adjusted input parameters to optimize combustion efficiency.
turkish_translation: Mühendisler yanma verimliliğini optimize etmek için girdi parametrelerini ayarladılar.
collocations: key parameter; statistical parameter; set parameters; experimental parameter

definition: an indicator, sign, or measure of something
example_sentence: The human development index combines education, income, and life expectancy measures.
turkish_translation: İnsani gelişme endeksi eğitim, gelir ve ortalama yaşam süresi ölçütlerini birleştirir.
collocations: development index; price index; refractive index; index of

definition: a thing that indicates the state or level of something
example_sentence: Water clarity is a reliable indicator of lake ecological health.
turkish_translation: Su berraklığı, gölün ekolojik sağlığının güvenilir bir göstergesidir.
collocations: key indicator; economic indicator; performance indicator; reliable indicator

definition: an object, gene, or feature that identifies a condition, location, or entity
example_sentence: DNA markers are used in forensic science to identify individual genetic profiles.
turkish_translation: DNA belirteçleri/markerları adli tıp biliminde bireysel genetik profilleri tanımlamak için kullanılır.
collocations: genetic marker; biological marker; diagnostic marker; marker gene

definition: a useful or valuable quality, person, or thing; property
example_sentence: Intellectual property is a key corporate asset in high-tech industries.
turkish_translation: Fikri mülkiyet, yüksek teknoloji endüstrilerinde temel bir kurumsal varlıktır/değerdir.
collocations: valuable asset; financial asset; corporate asset; key asset

definition: a supply of money, materials, staff, or assets that can be drawn on
example_sentence: Efficient resource management is essential for sustainable development.
turkish_translation: Sürdürülebilir kalkınma için verimli kaynak yönetimi esastır.
collocations: natural resources; human resources; allocation of resources; resource management

definition: the amount by which something is too small or falls short
example_sentence: Cognitive deficits were documented in patients following head trauma.
turkish_translation: Kafa travması geçiren hastalarda bilişsel eksiklikler/kayıplar belgelenmiştir.
collocations: budget deficit; cognitive deficit; trade deficit; deficit in

definition: an amount of something left over when requirements have been met; excess
example_sentence: Energy surplus generated by solar panels was fed back into the regional grid.
turkish_translation: Güneş panelleri tarafından üretilen enerji fazlası bölgesel şebekeye geri beslendi.
collocations: trade surplus; budget surplus; energy surplus; surplus value

definition: the amount of something produced by a system, machine, or individual
example_sentence: Cardiac output measures the volume of blood pumped by the heart per minute.
turkish_translation: Kardiyak debi/çıktı, kalbin dakikada pompaladığı kan hacmini ölçer.
collocations: cardiac output; economic output; high output; system output

definition: the way a thing turns out; a consequence or result
example_sentence: Patient health outcomes improved significantly under the new treatment protocol.
turkish_translation: Yeni tedavi protokolü altında hasta sağlık sonuçları önemli ölçüde iyileşmiştir.
collocations: health outcome; learning outcome; positive outcome; primary outcome

definition: the combination of ideas, elements, or compounds to form a complex whole
example_sentence: Literature review requires a critical synthesis of diverse research findings.
turkish_translation: Literatür taraması, çeşitli araştırma bulgularının eleştirel bir sentezini gerektirir.
collocations: data synthesis; protein synthesis; chemical synthesis; critical synthesis

definition: detailed examination of the elements or structure of something
example_sentence: Quantitative data analysis was performed using statistical software packages.
turkish_translation: Nicel veri analizi, istatistiksel yazılım paketleri kullanılarak gerçekleştirilmiştir.
collocations: data analysis; statistical analysis; qualitative analysis; comprehensive analysis

definition: the making of a judgment about the value, quality, or magnitude of something
example_sentence: Rigorous peer evaluation ensures high standards in scientific publishing.
turkish_translation: Sıkı akran değerlendirmesi, bilimsel yayıncılıkta yüksek standartları garanti eder.
collocations: peer evaluation; systematic evaluation; program evaluation; critical evaluation

definition: the action of putting something into operation; practical use
example_sentence: Clinical application of genetic engineering holds promise for rare diseases.
turkish_translation: Genetik mühendisliğinin klinik uygulaması, nadir hastalıklar için umut vaat etmektedir.
collocations: practical application; clinical application; industrial application; broad application

definition: the ability to see, hear, or become aware of something through the senses; interpretation
example_sentence: Visual perception involves complex processing within the brain's occipital cortex.
turkish_translation: Görsel algı, beynin oksipital korteksinde karmaşık işlemeyi içerir.
collocations: visual perception; public perception; depth perception; sensory perception

definition: the mental action or process of acquiring knowledge and understanding
example_sentence: Research in animal cognition reveals sophisticated problem-solving skills in primates.
turkish_translation: Hayvan bilişi üzerine yapılan araştırmalar, primatlarda gelişmiş problem çözme becerilerini ortaya koymaktadır.
collocations: animal cognition; human cognition; social cognition; spatial cognition

definition: the continued possession, use, or control of something; ability to remember
example_sentence: Long-term memory retention improves when information is connected to prior knowledge.
turkish_translation: Bilgi ön bilgiyle ilişkilendirildiğinde uzun süreli hafızada tutma/hatırlama gelişir.
collocations: memory retention; student retention; retention rate; employee retention

definition: the learning or developing of a skill, habit, or quality
example_sentence: Language acquisition studies examine how infants learn native phonemes naturally.
turkish_translation: Dil edinimi çalışmaları, bebeklerin ana dildeki fonemleri doğal olarak nasıl öğrendiklerini inceler.
collocations: language acquisition; data acquisition; skill acquisition; knowledge acquisition

definition: the state of being exposed to contact with something; experience
example_sentence: Early exposure to diverse languages enhances cognitive flexibility in children.
turkish_translation: Çeşitli dillere erken maruz kalma, çocuklarda bilişsel esnekliği artırır.
collocations: early exposure; prolonged exposure; exposure to; radiation exposure

definition: knowledge or perception of a situation or fact
example_sentence: Public awareness campaigns increased participation in cancer screening programs.
turkish_translation: Kamuoyu bilinçlendirme/farkındalık kampanyaları, kanser tarama programlarına katılımı artırdı.
collocations: public awareness; environmental awareness; raise awareness; spatial awareness

definition: cause something to arise or come about; produce energy or data
example_sentence: Wind turbines generate clean electrical power with zero operational carbon emissions.
turkish_translation: Rüzgar türbinleri, sıfır operasyonel karbon emisyonuyla temiz elektrik gücü üretir.
collocations: generate electricity; generate income; generate data; generate interest

definition: put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect
example_sentence: Schools will implement new curriculum guidelines starting next academic year.
turkish_translation: Okullar, önümüzdeki akademik yıldan itibaren yeni müfredat yönergelerini uygulamaya koyacaktır.
collocations: implement policy; implement changes; successfully implement; implement strategy

definition: intensify, increase, or further improve the quality or value of
example_sentence: Adding antioxidants to food packaging can enhance product shelf life.
turkish_translation: Gıda ambalajına antioksidanlar eklemek ürünün raf ömrünü artırabilir/geliştirebilir.
collocations: enhance quality; enhance performance; greatly enhance; enhance efficiency

definition: cause or enable a condition or state of affairs to continue
example_sentence: The cell membrane functions to maintain a stable internal chemical environment.

definition: impossible to believe; extraordinary

turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi derin deniz yaşamı hakkında inanılmaz keşifler yaptı.
collocations: incredible discovery; incredible; achievement; incredible story; absolutely; incredible

definition: at or to a point equidistant between two others
example_sentence: Students reached the halfway point of their semester abroad program.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler yurtdışı dönem programının yarı noktasına ulaştılar.
collocations: halfway through; halfway point; halfway; house; meet halfway

definition: the latest time or date by which something should be completed
example_sentence: All research papers must be submitted before the midnight deadline.
turkish_translation: Tüm araştırma makaleleri gece yarısı son teslim tarihinden önce teslim edilmelidir.
collocations: meet deadline; deadline pressure; strict; deadline; deadline extension

definition: a sudden loud, sharp noise
example_sentence: The chemistry experiment ended with a loud bang when the reaction occurred.
turkish_translation: Kimya deneyi reaksiyon gerçekleştiğinde yüksek bir patlamayla sona erdi.
collocations: loud bang; big bang; bang theory; door bang

definition: half; partly; almost
example_sentence: The research facility operates on a semi-autonomous system for data collection.
turkish_translation: Araştırma tesisi veri toplama için yarı otonom bir sistemle çalışır.
collocations: semi-automatic; semi-circle; semi-final; semi-private

definition: to cut with a violent sweeping movement; to reduce drastically
example_sentence: Budget cuts forced the university to slash funding for several research programs.
turkish_translation: Bütçe kesintileri üniversiteyi birkaç araştırma programı için finansmanı büyük ölçüde azaltmaya zorladı.
collocations: slash prices; slash budget; slash costs; slash; through

definition: deserving or inviting derision or mockery; absurd
example_sentence: The professor called the student’s excuse for missing class ridiculous and unacceptable.
turkish_translation: Profesör öğrencinin derse gelmeme bahanesini gülünç ve kabul edilemez olarak nitelendirdi.
collocations: absolutely ridiculous; ridiculous idea; ridiculous behavior; ridiculous excuse

definition: schoolwork assigned to be done outside the classroom
example_sentence: Students must complete their chemistry homework before tomorrow’s laboratory session.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler yarınki laboratuvar seansından önce kimya ödevlerini bitirmelidir.
collocations: homework assignment; finish homework; homework help; daily homework

definition: many; more than one
example_sentence: The research project requires multi-disciplinary collaboration between various departments.
turkish_translation: Araştırma projesi çeşitli bölümler arasında çok disiplinli işbirliği gerektiriyor.
collocations: multi-purpose; multi-cultural; multi-level; multi-national

definition: the faculty or power of using one’s will
example_sentence: Students participate in the study of their own volition without any external pressure.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler hiçbir dış baskı olmadan kendi iradeleriyle çalışmaya katılırlar.
collocations: own volition; free volition; act of volition; without volition

definition: requiring care and skill because difficult or awkward
example_sentence: The mathematical proof involves several tricky steps that require careful attention.
turkish_translation: Matematiksel ispat dikkatli özen gerektiren birkaç zor adım içerir.
collocations: tricky problem; tricky situation; tricky; question; quite tricky

definition: to shout for joy or in praise or encouragement
example_sentence: The audience began to cheer when the research team announced their breakthrough discovery.
turkish_translation: Araştırma ekibi çığır açan keşiflerini açıkladığında seyirciler alkışlamaya başladı.
collocations: cheer up; cheer for; cheer loudly; crowd; cheer

definition: a vehicle or object that travels regularly between two points
example_sentence: The campus shuttle transports students between dormitories and academic buildings.
turkish_translation: Kampüs servisi öğrencileri yurtlar ve akademik binalar arasında taşır.
collocations: space shuttle; shuttle service; shuttle bus; shuttle between

definition: a substance dispensed from a pressurized container as a fine spray
example_sentence: Environmental scientists study how aerosol particles affect atmospheric chemistry and climate.
turkish_translation: Çevre bilimcileri aerosol parçacıklarının atmosfer kimyasını ve iklimi nasıl etkilediğini inceler.
collocations: aerosol spray; aerosol can; aerosol; particles; aerosol pollution

definition: physically strong, fit, and active; relating to athletics
example_sentence: The university offers athletic scholarships to outstanding student athletes.
turkish_translation: Üniversite olağanüstü öğrenci sporculara atletizm bursları sunuyor.
collocations: athletic performance; athletic training; athletic scholarship; athletic department

definition: a board game for two players with pieces that have different powers
example_sentence: Computer scientists study chess algorithms to develop artificial intelligence systems.
turkish_translation: Bilgisayar bilimcileri yapay zeka sistemleri geliştirmek için satranç algoritmalarını inceler.
collocations: chess game; chess piece; chess tournament; chess strategy

definition: in a terrible manner; extremely
example_sentence: The laboratory experiment went terribly wrong due to contaminated samples.
turkish_translation: Kontamine örnekler nedeniyle laboratuvar deneyi son derece kötü gitti.
collocations: terribly wrong; terribly sorry; terribly; difficult; terribly important

definition: impossible to understand
example_sentence: The professor’s handwriting was completely unintelligible to the students.
turkish_translation: Profesörün el yazısı öğrenciler için tamamen anlaşılmazdı.
collocations: completely unintelligible; unintelligible; speech; unintelligible text; nearly; unintelligible

definition: approximately; around (used with dates)
example_sentence: The ancient manuscript was written circa 1200 CE according to historical analysis.
turkish_translation: Antik el yazması tarihsel analize göre yaklaşık MS 1200’de yazılmış.
collocations: circa 1800; circa the time; dating circa; written circa

definition: to move displayed text or images up or down on a computer screen
example_sentence: Students scroll through online research databases to find relevant academic articles.
turkish_translation: Öğrenciler ilgili akademik makaleleri bulmak için çevrimiçi araştırma veritabanlarında gezinir.
collocations: scroll down; scroll up; scroll through; scroll

definition: the position of being a sponsor; financial support
example_sentence: Corporate sponsorship enables universities to fund advanced research projects.
turkish_translation: Kurumsal sponsorluk üniversitelerin ileri araştırma projelerini finanse etmesini sağlar.
collocations: corporate sponsorship; sponsorship deal; seek sponsorship; sponsorship funding

definition: a thing that links two or more things together
example_sentence: The electrical connector allows researchers to link multiple instruments safely.
turkish_translation: Elektrik konektörü araştırmacıların birden fazla aleti güvenli şekilde bağlamasına olanak sağlar.
collocations: electrical connector; USB connector; connector cable; wireless connector

definition: very unpleasant; spiteful
example_sentence: The chemical reaction produced a nasty smell that required immediate ventilation.
turkish_translation: Kimyasal reaksiyon acil havalandırma gerektiren kötü bir koku üretti.
collocations: nasty smell; nasty surprise; nasty weather; nasty comment

definition: to an extraordinary degree; extremely
example_sentence: The new microscope is incredibly powerful, magnifying objects up to 10,000 times.
turkish_translation: Yeni mikroskop inanılmaz derecede güçlü, nesneleri 10.000 kata kadar büyütüyor.
collocations: incredibly powerful; incredibly difficult; incredibly important; incredibly fast

definition: new; revived
example_sentence: Neo-classical architecture influences modern university building designs.
turkish_translation: Neo-klasik mimari modern üniversite binası tasarımlarını etkiler.
collocations: te neo-classical; neo-liberal; neo-modern; neo-gothic

definition: a person or group that enters, joins, or takes part in something
example_sentence: Each new entrant to the graduate program must complete a research orientation course.
turkish_translation: Lisansüstü programa her yeni katılımcı bir araştırma oryantasyon dersi tamamlamalıdır.
collocations: new entrant; competition entrant; program; entrant; market entrant

definition: a bird of prey with broad rounded wings and a long tail
example_sentence: Ornithologists study hawk migration patterns to understand environmental changes.
turkish_translation: Ornitologlar çevresel değişiklikleri anlamak için şahin göç paternlerini inceler.
collocations: red hawk; hawk migration; hawk nest; sharp-shinned hawk

definition: something given free to a needy person or organization
example_sentence: The professor distributed handouts containing important formulas before the examination.
turkish_translation: Profesör sınavdan önce önemli formüller içeren notları dağıttı.
collocations: class handout; information handout; free; handout; study handout

definition: technology, especially computer technology
example_sentence: The university’s new tech center features cutting-edge equipment for student research.
turkish_translation: Üniversitenin yeni teknoloji merkezi öğrenci araştırması için son teknoloji ekipman içeriyor.
collocations: high tech; tech industry; tech support; tech; company

definition: a framework, typically with rails, bars, or pegs, for holding or storing things
example_sentence: The laboratory stores test tubes in organized racks for easy identification.
turkish_translation: Laboratuvar kolay tanımlama için test tüplerini düzenli raflarda saklar.
collocations: test tube rack; bike rack; wine rack; storage

definition: approval or praise expressed by clapping
example_sentence: The research presentation received enthusiastic applause from the academic audience.
turkish_translation: Araştırma sunumu akademik seyircilerden coşkulu alkış aldı.
collocations: loud applause; enthusiastic applause; thunderous applause; round of applause

definition: a person who shows how something works or is done
example_sentence: The chemistry demonstrator helped students understand complex laboratory procedures.
turkish_translation: Kimya demonstratörü öğrencilerin karmaşık laboratuvar prosedürlerini anlamasına yardımcı oldu.
collocations: laboratory demonstrator; teaching; demonstrator; product demonstrator; skilled demonstrator

definition: a small electronic device used for making mathematical calculations
example_sentence: Students are allowed to use scientific calculators during the physics examination.
turkish_translation: Öğrencilerin fizik sınavı sırasında bilimsel hesap makinesi kullanmasına izin verilir.
collocations: scientific calculator; graphing calculator; pocket calculator; solar calculator

definition: a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded
example_sentence: The new shopping mall near campus provides convenient services for university students.
turkish_translation: Kampüsün yakınındaki yeni alışveriş merkezi üniversite öğrencileri için uygun hizmetler sağlıyor.
collocations: shopping mall; strip mall; mega mall; outdoor mall

definition: to make a sudden involuntary expulsion of air from the nose and mouth
example_sentence: Laboratory workers must cover their mouth when they sneeze to prevent contamination.
turkish_translation: Laboratuvar çalışanları kontaminasyonu önlemek için hapşırdıklarında ağızlarını kapatmalıdır.
collocations: sneeze loudly; sneeze into elbow; sneeze fit; sudden sneeze

definition: to draw in air audibly through the nose to detect a smell or to stop it from running
example_sentence: The chemical detection unit was designed to sniff the air for volatile organic compounds.
turkish_translation: Kimyasal tespit ünitesi, uçucu organik bileşikler için havayı koklamak üzere tasarlandı.
collocations: sniff the air; sniff out; give a sniff; sniff; suspiciously

definition: a large, typically unroofed building with tiers of seats for spectators, used for sports or other large-scale events
example_sentence: The university’s new stadium will host the annual engineering competition, drawing participants from across the country.
turkish_translation: Üniversitenin yeni stadyumu, ülke çapından katılımcıların ilgisini çeken yıllık mühendislik yarışmasına ev sahipliği yapacak.
collocations: football stadium; sports stadium; olympic; stadium; stadium seating

definition: a person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor
example_sentence: In evolutionary biology, we study how each descendant species inherits traits from its ancestors.
turkish_translation: Evrimsel biyolojide, her bir torun türün atalarından nasıl özellikler miras aldığını inceleriz.
collocations: direct descendant; lineal descendant; common descendant; descendant of

definition: a supposition or proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation
example_sentence: The researcher formulated a clear hypothesis before beginning the experiment.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacı, deneye başlamadan önce net bir hipotez oluşturdu.
collocations: test a hypothesis; formulate a hypothesis; null hypothesis; working hypothesis

definition: having a random probability distribution or pattern that may be analyzed statistically but may not be predicted precisely
example_sentence: Stochastic models are used in finance and physics to represent systems that behave randomly.
turkish_translation: Stokastik modeller, rastgele davranan sistemleri temsil etmek için finans ve fizikte kullanılır.
collocations: stochastic process; stochastic model; stochastic variable; stochastic simulation

definition: a measure of the joint variability of two random variables
example_sentence: In statistics, the covariance indicates the direction of the linear relationship between two variables.
turkish_translation: İstatistikte, kovaryans iki değişken arasındaki doğrusal ilişkinin yönünü gösterir.
collocations: covariance matrix; sample covariance; calculate covariance; auto-covariance

definition: to bring or return to a normal or standard condition or state; to scale data to fall within a small, specified range
example_sentence: Before training the neural network, it is crucial to normalize the input data.
turkish_translation: Sinir ağını eğitmeden önce, girdi verisini normalleştirmek çok önemlidir.
collocations: normalize data; normalize a vector; normalize relations; normalize a database

definition: the process of bringing something to a normal condition; organizing columns and tables of a database to minimize data redundancy
example_sentence: Data normalization is a key step in pre-processing for many machine learning algorithms.
turkish_translation: Veri normalizasyonu, birçok makine öğrenmesi algoritması için ön işlemede anahtar bir adımdır.
collocations: data normalization; database; normalization; batch normalization; feature normalization

definition: the branch of metaphysics dealing with the nature of being; a formal representation of knowledge as a set of concepts within a domain
example_sentence: In computer science, an ontology is used to create a formal representation of knowledge.
turkish_translation: Bilgisayar biliminde, bir ontoloji bilginin biçimsel bir temsilini oluşturmak için kullanılır.
collocations: domain ontology; formal ontology; ontology; engineering; ontology mapping

definition: the theory of knowledge, especially with regard to its methods, validity, and scope; the investigation of what distinguishes justified belief from opinion
example_sentence: The professor’s course on epistemology explored how we can know what we claim to know.
turkish_translation: Profesörün epistemoloji dersi, bildiğimizi iddia ettiğimiz şeyi nasıl bilebileceğimizi araştırdı.
collocations: social epistemology; feminist epistemology; epistemology of science; epistemological; questions

definition: a philosophical approach to the study of experience and consciousness as it is lived from the first-person point of view
example_sentence: The research used phenomenology to explore the lived experiences of doctoral students during their dissertation process.
turkish_translation: Araştırma, doktora öğrencilerinin tez süreçlerindeki yaşanmış deneyimlerini keşfetmek için fenomenolojiyi kullandı.
collocations: hermeneutic phenomenology; transcendental phenomenology; phenomenology of perception; qualitative; phenomenology

definition: the scientific description of the customs of individual peoples and cultures, often involving participant observation
example_sentence: The anthropologist conducted an extensive ethnography of a remote community, living among them for two years.
turkish_translation: Antropolog, iki yıl boyunca aralarında yaşayarak uzak bir topluluğun kapsamlı bir etnografisini yürüttü.
collocations: qualitative ethnography; urban; ethnography; digital ethnography; ethnography study

definition: relating to or involving more than one branch of knowledge or academic discipline
example_sentence: The project required an interdisciplinary team of biologists, computer scientists, and ethicists.
turkish_translation: Proje, biyologlar, bilgisayar bilimcileri ve etikçilerden oluşan disiplinlerarası bir ekip gerektiriyordu.
collocations: interdisciplinary research; p interdisciplinary team; interdisciplinary; approach; interdisciplinary studies

definition: strong and healthy; (in statistics or computing) able to withstand or overcome adverse conditions or assumptions
example_sentence: The statistical model proved to be robust, yielding consistent results even with incomplete data.
turkish_translation: İstatistiksel model, eksik verilerle bile tutarlı sonuçlar vererek sağlam olduğunu kanıtladı.
collocations: robust model; robust algorithm; robust; design; statistically robust

definition: the quality of being able to withstand or overcome adverse conditions; the property of a system to resist change without losing its initial stable configuration
example_sentence: The robustness of the algorithm was tested against various types of unexpected inputs and system failures.
turkish_translation: Algoritmanın sağlamlığı, çeşitli beklenmedik girdilere ve sistem arızalarına karşı test edildi.
collocations: model robustness; statistical robustness; test for robustness; system robustness

definition: diverse in character or content; composed of parts of different kinds
example_sentence: The study population was highly heterogeneous, including participants from various cultural and economic backgrounds.
turkish_translation: Çalışma popülasyonu, çeşitli kültürel ve ekonomik geçmişlerden katılımcıları içeren oldukça heterojendi.
collocations: heterogeneous group; heterogeneous data; heterogeneous population; heterogeneous; mixture

definition: of the same kind; alike; consisting of parts all of the same kind
example_sentence: The experiment required a homogeneous sample to ensure the consistency and reliability of the results.
turkish_translation: Deney, sonuçların tutarlılığını ve güvenilirliğini sağlamak için homojen bir örnek gerektiriyordu.
collocations: homogeneous group; homogeneous; mixture; homogeneous population; homogeneous system

definition: having an internal cause or origin; (in economics) having its value determined by other variables in the model
example_sentence: In the economic model, price is an endogenous variable because it is determined by supply and demand within the system.
turkish_translation: Ekonomik modelde fiyat, sistem içindeki arz ve talep tarafından belirlendiği için içsel bir değişkendir.
collocations: endogenous variable; endogenous growth; endogenous factor; endogenous process

definition: relating to or developing from external factors; (in economics) having its value determined by factors outside the model
example_sentence: A natural disaster is considered an exogenous shock to an economic system.
turkish_translation: Doğal bir afet, bir ekonomik sisteme dışsal bir şok olarak kabul edilir.
collocations: exogenous variable; exogenous shock; exogenous factor; exogenous influence

definition: the principle that the simplest explanation of an event or observation is the preferred one
example_sentence: The principle of parsimony, also known as Occam’s razor, suggests we should favor the simplest scientific model that fits the evidence.
turkish_translation: Occam’ın usturası olarak da bilinen tutumluluk ilkesi, kanıta uyan en basit bilimsel modeli tercih etmemiz gerektiğini öne sürer.
collocations: principle of parsimony; maximum; parsimony; model parsimony; statistical; parsimony

definition: a variable that explains the process or mechanism through which two other variables are related
example_sentence: In the study, self-efficacy was identified as a key mediator between social support and academic achievement.
turkish_translation: Çalışmada, öz-yeterlik, sosyal destek ve akademik başarı arasında anahtar bir aracı olarak tanımlandı.
collocations: key mediator; statistical mediator; mediator variable; full mediator

definition: a variable that affects the direction and/or strength of the relationship between an independent and a dependent variable
example_sentence: The analysis revealed that age was a significant moderator of the relationship between exercise and cognitive function.
turkish_translation: Analiz, yaşın egzersiz ve bilişsel fonksiyon arasındaki ilişkinin önemli bir düzenleyicisi olduğunu ortaya koydu.
collocations: significant moderator; moderator variable; moderator analysis; potential moderator

definition: to define a concept or variable in terms of the specific and practical procedures or measurements used to assess it
example_sentence: To study ’anxiety’, researchers must operationalize it using measurable indicators like heart rate or a standardized questionnaire.
turkish_translation: Araştırmacılar, ’kaygı’yı incelemek için kalp atış hızı veya standart bir anket gibi ölçülebilir göstergeler kullanarak onu işlevselleştirmelidir.
collocations: operationalize a concept; operationalize; a variable; clearly operationalize; fail to; operationalize

definition: a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction without itself undergoing any permanent chemical change
example_sentence: Platinum is an effective catalyst for the reaction between hydrogen and oxygen to form water.
turkish_translation: Platin, su oluşturmak için hidrojen ve oksijen arasındaki reaksiyon için etkili bir katalizördür.
collocations: enzyme catalyst; chemical catalyst; act as a; catalyst; homogeneous catalyst

definition: the acceleration of a chemical reaction by a catalyst
example_sentence: The field of enzyme catalysis is essential for understanding biological processes and developing new drugs.
turkish_translation: Enzim katalizi alanı, biyolojik süreçleri anlamak ve yeni ilaçlar geliştirmek için esastır.
collocations: enzyme catalysis; acid-base catalysis; homogeneous catalysis; heterogeneous; catalysis

definition: each of two or more forms of the same element that contain equal numbers of protons but different numbers of neutrons in their nuclei
example_sentence: Carbon-14 is a radioactive isotope of carbon used in radiocarbon dating of ancient organic materials.
turkish_translation: Karbon-14, eski organik materyallerin radyokarbon tarihlemesinde kullanılan radyoaktif bir karbon izotopudur.
collocations: radioactive isotope; stable isotope; isotope; analysis; isotope ratio

definition: a large molecule, or macromolecule, composed of many repeated subunits
example_sentence: DNA is a natural polymer composed of nucleotide monomers that carries genetic information.
turkish_translation: DNA, genetik bilgiyi taşıyan nükleotid monomerlerinden oluşan doğal bir polimerdir.
collocations: synthetic polymer; natural polymer; polymer chain; polymer science

definition: the mathematical study of the properties of space that are preserved under continuous deformations
example_sentence: Network topology describes the arrangement of nodes and connections in a communication network, such as a star or ring formation.
turkish_translation: Ağ topolojisi, bir iletişim ağındaki düğümlerin ve bağlantıların yıldız veya halka oluşumu gibi düzenini tanımlar.
collocations: network topology; algebraic topology; data; topology; point-set topology

definition: a special scalar value that, when a matrix is multiplied by a vector, yields the same vector scaled by the eigenvalue
example_sentence: In principal component analysis, each eigenvalue represents the amount of variance explained by its corresponding eigenvector.
turkish_translation: Temel bileşenler analizinde, her bir özdeğer, karşılık gelen özvektörü tarafından açıklanan varyans miktarını temsil eder.
collocations: eigenvalue decomposition; calculate; eigenvalue; dominant eigenvalue; eigenvalue problem

definition: a non-zero vector that, when multiplied by a matrix, results in a new vector that is a scalar multiple of the original
example_sentence: The eigenvector corresponding to the highest eigenvalue indicates the direction of maximum variance in the data.
turkish_translation: En yüksek özdeğere karşılık gelen özvektör, verideki maksimum varyans yönünü gösterir.
collocations: dominant eigenvector; principal eigenvector; eigenvector analysis; normalized eigenvector

definition: A factor which decisively affects the nature or outcome of something; in mathematics, a scalar value that is a function of the entries of a square matrix.
example_sentence: Socioeconomic status is a major determinant of educational attainment and health outcomes.
turkish_translation: Sosyoekonomik durum, eğitim seviyesi ve sağlık sonuçlarının önemli bir belirleyicisidir.
collocations: key determinant; major determinant; social; determinant; determinant of health

definition: A mathematical object that describes linear relationships between geometric vectors, scalars, and other tensors, often represented as a multi-dimensional array.
example_sentence: In physics, Einstein’s theory of general relativity uses tensors to describe the curvature of spacetime.
turkish_translation: Fizikte, Einstein’ın genel görelilik teorisi, uzay-zamanın eğriliğini tanımlamak için tensörleri kullanır.
collocations: tensor field; stress tensor; tensor calculus; rank-2 tensor

definition: A group of people with a common characteristic, particularly age, who are studied over a period of time in a scientific study.
example_sentence: The longitudinal study followed a cohort of children from birth to adulthood to track their development.
turkish_translation: Boylamsal çalışma, gelişimlerini izlemek için doğumdan yetişkinliğe kadar bir çocuk kohortunu takip etti.
collocations: birth cohort; cohort study; cohort analysis; cohort of students

definition: The relationship between cause and effect; the principle that everything has a cause.
example_sentence: Establishing causality, rather than mere correlation, is a fundamental challenge in social science research.
turkish_translation: Sadece korelasyon yerine nedenselliği kurmak, sosyal bilimler araştırmasında temel bir zorluktur.
collocations: establish causality; principle of causality; reverse causality; linear causality

definition: A conditional statement expressing what would have happened if a particular event or situation had been different.
example_sentence: To assess the program’s impact, we compared the actual outcome with a counterfactual scenario where the program did not exist.
turkish_translation: Programın etkisini değerlendirmek için, gerçek sonucu programın var olmadığı bir karşı-olgusal senaryo ile karşılaştırdık.
collocations: counterfactual thinking; counterfactual; analysis; counterfactual conditional; generate a counterfactual

definition: Awareness and understanding of one’s own thought processes; thinking about thinking.
example_sentence: Effective learners use metacognition to monitor their understanding and adjust their study strategies accordingly.
turkish_translation: Etkili öğrenciler, anlayışlarını izlemek ve çalışma stratejilerini buna göre ayarlamak için üstbilişi kullanırlar.
collocations: metacognition skills; promote; metacognition; metacognition strategies; develop metacognition

definition: A mental shortcut or rule of thumb that enables a person to make judgments and solve problems quickly and efficiently.
example_sentence: While a heuristic can be useful for quick decisions, it can sometimes lead to systematic errors or cognitive biases.
turkish_translation: Bir sezgisel yöntem hızlı kararlar için yararlı olabilirken, bazen sistematik hatalara veya bilişsel yanlılıklara yol açabilir.
collocations: availability heuristic; representative; heuristic; simple heuristic; use a heuristic

definition: The tendency of a system, especially the physiological system of higher animals, to maintain a stable, constant internal environment.
example_sentence: The human body maintains homeostasis through processes like regulating temperature and blood sugar levels.
turkish_translation: İnsan vücudu, sıcaklığı ve kan şekeri seviyelerini düzenlemek gibi süreçlerle homeostazı korur.
collocations: maintain homeostasis; physiological; homeostasis; cellular homeostasis; disrupt; homeostasis

definition: The evolutionary history and development of a species or group of organisms, often depicted as a branching tree.
example_sentence: Scientists use genetic data to construct a phylogeny showing the evolutionary relationships between different species.
turkish_translation: Bilim insanları, farklı türler arasındaki evrimsel ilişkileri gösteren bir filogeni oluşturmak için genetik verileri kullanır.
collocations: molecular phylogeny; construct a; phylogeny; phylogenetic tree; species; phylogeny

definition: The development or course of development of an individual organism from the earliest stage to maturity.
example_sentence: The study of ontogeny traces the developmental changes an organism undergoes throughout its entire life.
turkish_translation: Ontojeni çalışması, bir organizmanın tüm yaşamı boyunca geçirdiği gelişimsel değişiklikleri izler.
collocations: individual ontogeny; ontogeny and phylogeny; human ontogeny; study of ontogeny
